basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old culinary enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I recently started playing No Man's Sky and enjoy exploring its vast universe in my spare time. By day, I work as a sous chef at a popular local restaurant. When I'm not experimenting with new recipes, I'm diving into sci-fi games or catching up on the latest Netflix series. I identify as non-binary and am currently single. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after my restaurant shifts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to both Reddit and No Man's Sky, but I'm a fast learner. My culinary skills are mainly self-taught, honed through years of practice and experimenting in the kitchen. I have a keen interest in sci-fi and gaming, which I explore through various online communities.
